# Workarounds

Platform quirks the code protects itself from. Never remove one until its symptom is reproduced on that platform, and check a change to one on every platform CI runs.

| workaround | rule | code |
| ---------- | ---- | ---- |
| [archive-search-ignore](workarounds/archive-search-ignore.md) | List the archive folder in the store's .ignore; its leading dot is not enough. | `src/core/store/search-ignore.ts` |
| [bun-shell-backslash](workarounds/bun-shell-backslash.md) | Paths substituted into a verify command use forward slashes. | `src/core/verify/command.ts` |
| [bun-test-timeout](workarounds/bun-test-timeout.md) | Run the whole suite through `bun run test`, which passes --timeout on the command line. | none: The fix is a flag in package.json, which has no comment to carry an anchor. |
| [bun-yaml-error-line](workarounds/bun-yaml-error-line.md) | Never report the line of a Bun.YAML error; parse field by field when the line matters. | `src/core/config/load.ts`, `src/core/rules/builtin/front-matter.ts` |
| [child-holds-pipe](workarounds/child-holds-pipe.md) | Stop reading a command's output shortly after it exits, even if the pipe is still open. | `src/core/verify/shell.ts` |
| [child-stdin-closed](workarounds/child-stdin-closed.md) | Start every child process with stdin closed. | `src/core/git/deletion.ts`, `src/core/git/git.ts`, `src/core/verify/shell.ts` |
| [claude-project-key](workarounds/claude-project-key.md) | Key projects in Claude Code's user config with forward slashes. | `src/clients/claude/local.ts` |
| [clip-exe-codepage](workarounds/clip-exe-codepage.md) | On Windows, copy through a UTF-8 file and PowerShell, never clip.exe. | `src/core/adapters/clipboard.ts` |
| [compiled-bun-be-bun](workarounds/compiled-bun-be-bun.md) | Set BUN_BE_BUN=1 when a process re-runs itself as Bun. | `src/core/verify/shell.ts` |
| [git-add-unknown-path](workarounds/git-add-unknown-path.md) | Hand git add only paths that are on disk or known to git. | `src/core/sync/git-steps.ts` |
| [git-hook-variables](workarounds/git-hook-variables.md) | Strip GIT_DIR, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_PREFIX from every child's environment. | `src/core/git/git.ts` |
| [git-quoted-paths](workarounds/git-quoted-paths.md) | Run git with core.quotePath=false wherever its output names files. | `src/core/index/history.ts`, `src/core/index/line-diff.ts`, `src/core/migrate/drift.ts`, `src/core/migrate/resync.ts` |
| [path-spelling](workarounds/path-spelling.md) | Compare paths through their real targets, ignoring case on Windows; never by string. | `src/core/git/git.ts`, `src/core/text/real-path.ts` |
| [posix-relative-cwd](workarounds/posix-relative-cwd.md) | Call posix.relative only with absolute paths; store-relative ones go under a deep fake root. | `src/core/edit/links.ts` |
| [rebase-opens-editor](workarounds/rebase-opens-editor.md) | Run git pull --rebase and rebase --continue with core.editor=true. | `src/core/sync/git-steps.ts` |
| [windows-command-line](workarounds/windows-command-line.md) | Pass paths to git in batches of 100 at most. | `src/core/index/history.ts` |
